description: Phone video of the first printed whistle (v0.1 print file, article 0efcea4610ab) shown in one piece and played: closed and open notes, finger moves between them

extractions.what: The first print (v0.1 file) is one piece and speaks: a clear tone from 7.6 s to 14.7 s, 524 playing frames, none without a clear tone
Closed note as played, untrimmed vent: 342.8 Hz at the softest stable breath, 355.9 Hz middle, 380.5 Hz loudest (C21 band 313 to 367 Hz)
Open note as played: stable segments 497.6 to 512.6 Hz, median 503.1 Hz, falling to about 472 Hz near -20 dBFS as the breath fades (C22 band 432 to 508 Hz)
The note moves between the closed and open pitches through 400 to 410 Hz with no break in the tone
Loudness is not readable from this video: uncalibrated phone level (dBFS), unknown distance, possible automatic gain
